title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior is adopted and maintained in a population under social influence, policies, media messaging, and supply constraints, optionally coupled with infection dynamics.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers' visible mask-wearing and update beliefs and adoption probability based on social norms and homophily.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask policies via reminders, fines, or access control, affecting compliance and perceived costs.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media channels disseminate messages that change risk perception, perceived efficacy, and trust; misinformation can reduce adoption.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals acquire masks subject to inventory, price, and affordability; supply constraints delay or reduce adoption.

interactions.name: contacts_and_transmission
interactions.description: Agents interact at locations; mask use, mask quality, and ventilation modulate infection transmission risk (optional epidemiological coupling).

interactions.name: observation_and_norm_internalization
interactions.description: Repeated exposure to high local compliance strengthens internal norms and reduces future fatigue or backsliding.

interactions.name: employer_policy_effects
interactions.description: Workplaces/schools with stricter policies increase on-site compliance and may spill over to off-site behavior.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption reaches 50%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration
metrics.description: Number of consecutive days adoption remains above a threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: subgroup_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographic or socioeconomic subgroups.

metrics.name: policy_enforcement_events
metrics.description: Count of warnings/fines issued; proxy for enforcement burden.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in infections compared to a no-mask baseline (if epidemiology modeled).

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated Rt over time under observed mask adoption (if epidemiology modeled).

metrics.name: campaign_cost_effectiveness
metrics.description: Adoption gain per unit of communication or enforcement spending.
